title: When Cars Have Stereotypes: Auditing Demographic Bias in Objects from Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing visual attributes of text-to-image generated objects prompted with explicit age-related cues (e.g., 'for elderly') against neutrally prompted objects, using GPT-4o for automated attribute extraction and Jensen-Shannon divergence metrics.

Comparing visual attributes of text-to-image generated objects prompted with explicit gender-related cues (e.g., 'for women') against neutrally prompted objects, using GPT-4o for automated attribute extraction and Jensen-Shannon divergence metrics.

Comparing visual attributes of text-to-image generated objects prompted with explicit ethnicity-related cues (e.g., 'for Asian people') against neutrally prompted objects, using GPT-4o for automated attribute extraction and Jensen-Shannon divergence metrics.
